about.milestone_1990: The beginning of a thirty-year passion
about.philosophy_text: I don't just design spaces, I establish connections. My goal is to accompany nature in its return to simplicity, so that those who live in the garden can perceive themselves as part of the surrounding horizon, with the emotional fantasy of the soul.
about.story_text: In 1990, my journey into the plant world began almost in silence, driven by family necessity. But what was born as a duty turned, day after day, into an overwhelming passion. I fell in love with the purity of plants and their resilient ability to exist, simply, finding myself fascinated by the microsystems developed in every garden I create.
about.subtitle: Thirty years of dialogue with nature
about.title: About Us

aboutPage.case_history_text: One of my most significant projects was the recovery of the park of a villa from the 1700s in semi-abandonment. I listened to what the park wanted to become again, restoring historical symmetries and secular essences, transforming it into an excellent setting for VIP events and absolute relaxation, without ever breaking the dialogue with the surrounding landscape.
aboutPage.gallery_villa_mussio: Villa Mussio, a few shots of the work
aboutPage.hero_subtitle: My story and the vision for SUBGarden
aboutPage.hero_title: Working with plants and gardens since 1990
aboutPage.innovation_text: My passion for nature led me to create SUBGarden: a patented non-invasive sub-irrigation system. I protect the value of historical and modern gardens with a technology that is not seen, does not destroy the existing lawn during installation, and guarantees eternal beauty, supported by digital precision and absolute respect for the water resource.
aboutPage.philosophy_expanded_text1: A garden doesn't end where the property line stops. My technique is inspired by the concept of 'Borrowed Scenery': freeing the gaze rather than delimiting it. I use natural wings and perspective telescopes to merge the private garden with the infinite horizon of Tuscany.
aboutPage.philosophy_expanded_text2: I define my approach as 'Empathetic Garden' because it resonates with the inhabitants and the place itself. I don't impose a form, but follow the voice of the earth, using the most advanced technology to serve the greatest simplicity.
aboutPage.philosophy_expanded_title: Borrowed scenery and the empathetic garden
aboutPage.roots_text: In 1990 I wasn't looking for a career, but for answers. What started as support for the family business quickly became an intimate dialogue with the plant world. I was won over by the ability of plants to 'simply exist', their silent but invincible resilience. Since then, every garden I create is a tribute to this strength.
aboutPage.roots_ancient_text: Our story does not begin thirty years ago, but four thousand. We draw inspiration from the masters of the Nile and the sages of the Han dynasty, who understood before us how water must be a secret dialogue between earth and root. SUBGarden does nothing but give this ancient wisdom the precision of modern engineering.
aboutPage.case_history_focus: In residences that have witnessed history, we cannot afford to break the spell with visible modern technology. Our non-invasive installation method is the only one that allows us to preserve secular essences and Renaissance symmetries, bringing water to the roots exactly as the Medici gardeners would have wished.

benefits.title: Water savings and stress-free installation
benefits.subtitle: Two pillars of the SUBGarden system: less waste, maximum simplicity of installation even in existing gardens.
benefits.water_lead: Water goes only where it's needed, deep down. No evaporation, no runoff: up to 60-70% savings compared to sprinkler irrigation.
benefits.water_1: Distribution by capillarity in the soil: even and slow, for the benefit of the roots.
benefits.water_2: Low pressure and low flow (1.6 l/h per emitter): no heavy pumping, maximum efficiency.
benefits.water_3: Fertigation possible without contact with chemical synthesis products on the surface.
benefits.water_4: Distribution uniformity >90%: no dry or stagnant areas (Rain Bird XFS drip line, Copper Shield™).
benefits.install_lead: Our patented system installs in existing gardens without tearing up the lawn: fast, clean intervention that respects existing greenery.
benefits.install_1: Patented installation: no invasive digging, the turf stays intact.
benefits.install_2: Short lead times and a tidy site: the garden is ready to use right away.
benefits.install_3: No destruction of greenery: suitable for historic lawns and high-value settings too.
benefits.install_4: Smart reconversion of existing systems: reuse of lines, total anti-vandalism protection.

technologyPage.evolution_title: Water underground, as it has always been
technologyPage.evolution_text: From terracotta to polymer: the principle is the same, the technology has changed. Where the ancient Egyptians used the porosity of clay, we use patented self-compensating emitters to ensure every root receives the right amount of moisture, drop by drop, with no evaporation and no waste.
technologyPage.hero_title: Water goes to the roots, the lawn stays dry
technologyPage.hero_lead: Under the lawn we lay Rain Bird XFS dripline in a grid. Here you will find how it works, the data sheet figures and how we work on site.
technologyPage.soil_lead: The driplines sit a few centimetres deep, in parallel rows. Each emitter releases a little water at a time and the soil spreads it by itself, through capillary action.
technologyPage.soil_figure: Cross-section of the soil: the lawn on top, the roots, Rain Bird XFS driplines 30 cm apart and the water rising towards the roots
technologyPage.soil_1_text: The surface stays dry: no puddles, no spray on the furniture, you can walk on it straight away.
technologyPage.soil_2_text: They get the water directly, with no evaporation and no runoff.
technologyPage.soil_3_text: Rain Bird XFS, pressure-compensating from 0.4 to 3.6 atm: every emitter delivers 1.6 l/h, at the start of the line as at the end.
technologyPage.soil_4_text: It spreads slowly and evenly by capillary action and rises towards the roots. Efficiency is above 90%.
technologyPage.specs_title: The Rain Bird XFS dripline in figures
technologyPage.specs_lead: The figures that matter, from the product data sheet and our installation layout.
technologyPage.spec_flow_note: Low flow and low pressure: no large pumps or storage tanks needed.
technologyPage.spec_pressure_note: Across this whole range every emitter delivers the same amount of water.
technologyPage.spec_grid_note: Parallel lines, 300 mm from one line to the next.
technologyPage.spec_efficiency_note: Water does not evaporate or run off the surface.
technologyPage.feature_1: Emitters that self-flush at every cycle
technologyPage.feature_2: Root intrusion protection for the emitters (Copper Shield)
technologyPage.feature_3: Air relief valves on every zone
technologyPage.feature_4: Filter and pressure regulator after the valve
technologyPage.feature_5: Pipe flushing without activating the emitters
technologyPage.install_text: The installation method is patented: the lines go under the lawn without invasive digging. The turf is not removed, roots and fixed furniture stay where they are, and once the job is done the system cannot be seen.
technologyPage.install_text_2: The same network can be used for fertigation: fertiliser reaches the roots and does not sit on the lawn where people walk. Maintenance is done from the zone valves, without touching the garden.
technologyPage.install_image_alt: Illustration made for SUBGarden: an Italian garden with the buried XFS dripline and the 1.6 l/h pressure-compensating emitter
technologyPage.evolution_image_alt: Illustration made for SUBGarden: from terracotta ollas and the blue lotus of ancient Egypt to the Medici villas and the Rain Bird XFS dripline

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: The questions we are asked most about subsurface irrigation, installation, water use and costs.
faq.q1_q: Can sub-irrigation be installed in an existing garden?
faq.q1_a: Yes. The SUBGarden system is designed for gardens that are already in place. Installation is non-invasive and does not require digging up or destroying the lawn: the turf stays intact and the garden can be used immediately after the work.
faq.q2_q: Does installation damage the lawn or garden?
faq.q2_a: No. Thanks to the patented method, drip lines are laid without invasive digging. The turf is not removed or damaged; the work is quick, clean and respectful of the greenery you already have.
faq.q3_q: How much water do you save with sub-irrigation compared to sprinklers?
faq.q3_a: Water saving can reach up to 70% compared to traditional irrigation. Water goes directly to the roots, with no surface evaporation or runoff, and over 90% efficiency.
faq.q4_q: How much does it cost and how do I get a quote?
faq.q4_a: The cost depends on the area, the layout of the garden and your specific needs. We offer a free site visit to assess your space and propose a tailored solution. Contact us to book an appointment.
faq.q5_a: We operate in Tuscany (Elba Island, Maremma, Livorno, San Vincenzo and province) and are expanding across Italy. You can find the areas we cover in the Territory section.
faq.q6_q: What maintenance does the system need?
faq.q6_a: Maintenance is minimal. The system is automated with scheduling and alerts; you can control it from your smartphone with the app. Periodic checks and technical support are available as needed.
faq.q7_q: What is the difference between sub-irrigation and sprinkler irrigation?
faq.q7_a: Sprinkler irrigation wets the surface: some water evaporates or runs off, and the lawn stays wet (with possible issues like mosquitoes and limited use of the garden). Sub-irrigation delivers water deep to the roots: dry surface, less waste, water saving and more comfort.
faq.q8_a: It varies according to the size and complexity of the garden. Thanks to the absence of invasive digging, the site stays tidy and the garden can be used right after installation.
faq.cta_lead: Write or call us: the site visit is free.
